_about: bd-97daxo.33: the areas an analytics view splits a region into, as data. Key = the region as schools.region and the region registry spell it; each area lists the districts (schools.district) it holds, in dashboard order. Source: Moawin's GB pilot workbook (Rumi_GB_Pilot_Data_Collection.xlsm), tab 'Schools & Contacts' (Region, District) and tab 'Lists' (Astore, Ghizer, Darel are Gilgit's). A district not listed here puts its school under 'Area not set'. Access never follows this file: it stays on schools.region.
